SafeMath.sub on the caller allowance inside decreaseAllowance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by _msgSender, which is the authorization subject for owner-restricted logic.
transfer passes _msgSender() as the sender into _transfer.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance deduction.
increaseAllowance reads and writes the allowance of _msgSender().
decreaseAllowance reads and writes the allowance of _msgSender().
mint credits newly created tokens to _msgSender().
renounceOwnership is gated by onlyOwner, which compares _owner with _msgSender().
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner, which compares _owner with _msgSender().
transfer delegates the balance mutation to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the balance mutation to _transfer.
transferFrom updates the remaining allowance through _approve.
approve writes the allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance writes the new allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the new allowance through _approve.
mint is onlyOwner restricted and creates tokens via _mint.
_burnFrom calls _burn to destroy the tokens.
_burnFrom reduces the caller allowance via _approve.
transferOwnership delegates the ownership write to _transferOwnership.
getOwner returns the result of owner().
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
_transferOwnership writes the new value into _owner.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to the zero address.
_transfer mutates the _balances mapping for sender and recipient.
_mint credits the account balance in _balances.
_burn debits the account balance in _balances.
balanceOf reads _balances[account].
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
_approve writes the nested _allowances mapping.
_transfer performs _balances[sender].sub(amount); unchecked subtraction would underflow the balance.
_transfer performs _balances[recipient].add(amount); unchecked addition would overflow the balance.
_mint performs _totalSupply.add(amount); unchecked addition could overflow the supply.
transferFrom subtracts the spent amount from the spender allowance.
increaseAllowance adds addedValue to the caller allowance.
decreaseAllowance subtracts subtractedValue from the caller allowance.
_burn performs _totalSupply.sub(amount) which must not underflow.
_burnFrom subtracts the burned amount from the caller allowance.
recipient parameter is consumed by transfer.
amount parameter is consumed by transfer.
transfer recipient flows into _transfer as the credited account.
transfer amount flows into _transfer for balance adjustments.
_transfer sender parameter selects the debited balance slot.
_transfer recipient parameter selects the credited balance slot.
_transfer amount parameter drives the debit and credit operations.
sender parameter indexes _balances for the SafeMath.sub debit.
amount parameter is the subtracted value in the SafeMath.sub debit.
recipient parameter indexes _balances for the SafeMath.add credit.
amount parameter is the added value in the SafeMath.add credit.
account parameter of _mint is the credited balance slot.
amount parameter of _mint is the minted quantity.
mint amount is the added value in the _totalSupply SafeMath.add.
account parameter of _burn is the debited balance slot.
amount parameter of _burn is the burned quantity.
burn amount is the subtracted value in the _totalSupply SafeMath.sub.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only has meaning as the destination argument of the external transfer entry point.
The transfer amount parameter is forwarded to __transfer, where it drives the balance arithmetic.
The internal sender parameter is a transient alias of the balance slot operated on by _transfer.
The internal recipient parameter is a transient alias of the balance slot operated on by _transfer.
The internal amount parameter is consumed directly by the SafeMath.sub debit operation.
The mint account parameter is only used as the credited balance slot inside _mint.
The mint amount parameter is consumed directly by the SafeMath.add on _totalSupply.
The burn account parameter is only used as the debited balance slot inside _burn.
The burn amount parameter is consumed directly by the SafeMath.sub on _totalSupply.
